places-maina-abrigo-del-mediodia-i.story: 355 km from Totana to Totana, about 6 h 07 of riding. On the way it passes Los Grajos, Cueva de los Pucheros, Abrigo de los Cortijos and Abrigo del mediodía I. The highest point is about 800 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
